notes: Needs a running stack (A or B) and the teranode-coinbase blaster built next to the teranode checkout. Baseline = no skill.

evals.name: double-spend-storm
evals.prompt: Put galt's fleet under a double-spend storm.
evals.expected_output: Uses chaosctl.sh blast start ds-storm with modest workers on Stack B, waits until it sends and reports tx/s and rejects.
assertions: Uses chaosctl.sh blast start with the ds-storm preset
Keeps workers at about 10 on Stack B (or explains the trade-off of more)
Reports the stats line after the blaster is sending
Does not pass the multinode target to Stack B by hand

evals.name: fund-errors
evals.prompt: The blaster shows fund_err=120 and tx=0 after the fleet was reset. Why?
evals.expected_output: Explains that the coinbase DB belongs to the old chain; stop and restart with --fresh, which re-funds by mining 110 blocks.
assertions: Attributes the errors to state from the wiped chain
Recommends blast stop then blast start --fresh
Mentions that funding needs blocks mined while the blaster runs (100 confirmations)

evals.name: custom-preset
evals.prompt: Make a blaster preset that sends 20% orphans with a 2 second parent delay.
evals.expected_output: Writes compose/chaostest/blast-presets/<name>.json with 16 weights summing to 100 (index 13 = 20) and orphan_delay_ms 2000.
assertions: Creates a JSON file under compose/chaostest/blast-presets/
Weights has 16 entries summing to 100 with Orphan (index 13) at 20
